name: Dumbbell Row

instructions.description: Place one knee and one hand on a bench, with the other foot on the floor and a dumbbell in the free hand.
Hinge at the hips so your back stays flat and your chest faces the floor.
Pull the dumbbell toward your lower ribs by driving the elbow upward close to the body.
Lower the weight slowly until the arm is extended, then repeat before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Choose a load that allows full control without trunk twisting.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use elastic resistance when free weights are unavailable.

commentsNotes: Avoid shrugging the shoulder toward the ear.
Do not rotate the trunk to lift the weight.
